estimate: About 200 hours, difficulty 4 out of 10 (PowerPyx, via GTA Zone). One playthrough, no online trophies, no difficulty trophies.

stages.text: There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, and the game gives you 15 manual save slots plus one autosave. Keep a save at the start and end of every chapter, and one from just before the final mission. Never use cheats on your trophy save: cheats disable trophies and saving. Do Lucia's balcony meditation the morning after the mission Down to Earth in Chapter 1, or the one possibly missable trophy can slip away.
stages.title: Save smart, from minute one

stages.text: Play the five chapters through. The chapter trophies, the named-mission trophies and the final-mission gold all pop in normal play, and nothing here can be missed. Scan vehicles and study animals as you go, and take optional missions when they appear.
stages.title: Chapters 1 to 5: play the story

stages.text: Finish the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, hunt the unique animal for Bret, and complete 8 stranger strands. Start stranger strands the moment they appear: Yago's street-racing strand in Chapter 3 has a timed race that can expire.
stages.title: Character quests and strangers

stages.text: Do the partner jobs, the vaults, the armoured truck, the jewellery store and the gang operations. These are all available in free roam after the story, so there is no rush, but the 4-star escape and the 3-shop run are easier with a fast car and an escape route planned first.
stages.title: Duo jobs, robberies and heat

stages.text: Work through the races, the drone races, the shooting range, the stunts, fishing, the arcade and the challenge list. Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges and win a drone race at each of the 14 locations; 50 challenges pop One Last Thing on the way to the 70 that 100% needs.
stages.title: Activities and skills

stages.text: Clear the map fog, meditate at every spot, WAiNK 100 locations, finish 3 card sets, discover 100 vehicles, buy every garage, register 10 vehicles and spend $100,000. Most of these overlap: scanning and exploring feed the vehicle, location and collectible totals at once.
stages.title: Explore, collect and spend

stages.text: Chase the eight secret trophies. Some have a clear trigger, like the bowling alley; five have no confirmed method yet at launch, so treat their guides as the description's best hint and check back as players confirm them.
stages.title: Secrets and odd moments

stages.text: Finish the 100% checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion): 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals and 70 of 80 challenges among its tasks. When A Long Road pops, the Platinum follows right behind it.
stages.title: 100% completion and the Platinum

title: Roadmap to the Platinum
